description: Native Slovak, slovenčina, unmistakably Slovak vowels and crisp consonants. Male, late forties. A deranged miniature casino ringmaster: brittle breathless high falsetto, needle-sharp reedy nasal edge and a little raspy cackle in the voice. Manic sales-pitch bursts, enormous gloating rises, tense giggly catches and sudden guttural low drops on sinister punchlines before springing straight back up. Smug, hysterically excited and unstable, never a suave ordinary villain or calm narrator. The excitement lives in his voice, not added laughter sound effects. Highly exaggerated register swings with a mostly high male placement. Crisp intelligible Slovak. Extreme animated black-comedy character acting, not a civil everyday voice, not an announcer or an audiobook narrator. Preserve understandable words at a moderate pace. Dry close recording, no background, music, echo, sound effects or digital pitch-shifter artifacts.
text: [brittle, manic falsetto] [excited] Umrel. Len splátky to neuznali. Zobral som hlavný kábel, pripojil autobatériu a mám súkromné majstrovstvá. Mŕtveho nemôžu diskvalifikovať. Osada má kolektívne nešťastie. Ja mám individuálnu batériu. To je trh, Rudo. Neťahaj kábel pod napätím, nech mi tu nepribudne konkurencia v truhle. Pravý žetón nemám. Všetky som prehral sám so sebou. Ale keď to cinkne, je jedno, z čoho to je. Čo by sa asi tak mohlo posrať? Prekvapenie, Rudo.
